body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its 4.8-inch UMPC prototype during CES 2008, which is based on Intel's Menlow platform and Silverthorn CPU.
Adopting a sliding touch screen and qwerty keyboard, it is equipped with 1GB DDR2 memory and 40GB hard drive. It also supports HSDPA, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity.
